bio: Jonathan Septer Kreiss-Tomkins (born February 7, 1989), also known as JKT, is an American politician who served as a member of the Alaska House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023. A Democrat, he represented the state's 35th district, which encompasses many Southeast island communities, including Hoonah, Sitka, Kake, Klawock, Craig, Angoon and Petersburg. Kreiss-Tomkins is a candidate in the 2026 Alaska gubernatorial election.
